description: S7 follow-up — repeats kill-worker with a host I/O probe (dirty page cache, iowait, blocked tasks every 5 s) and partition-ownership snapshots every 20 s, to explain the slow, erratic catch-up seen in s7 kill-worker at 45k. Second case at 30k ev/s (~46% of the 65k knee) shows recovery with more headroom. Local only.

Actions.Name: spread-loop
Actions.Run: nohup sh -c 'for i in $(seq 1 40); do test/stress/scripts/group-spread.sh stress-s7- test/stress/results/s7-probe/spread-kill-worker-45k.txt; sleep 20; done' >/dev/null 2>&1 &
